name: Adafruit Metro RP2350
description: UNO-format RP2350B board with 16 MB flash, microSD, HSTX port for DVI video, STEMMA QT, USB-C and DC jack: shield-compatible and CircuitPython-friendly.
notes: Uses the 80-pin RP2350B (48 GPIO); A0-A5 are GPIO41-46.
37 GPIO per Adafruit = headers + 12 on the HSTX port + 2 for the USB host pads.
DC jack accepts 6-17 V; 3.3 V logic only (UNO shields must be 3.3 V compatible).
Ships with an RP2350 A2 stepping, which has documented GPIO/PIO errata. A PSRAM variant exists as a separate product.
UNO-style pin positions: digital headers along one long edge, power/analog on the other.
